Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Mote — For further details about the dimensions of the letters and numerals, reference maybe made to 
IS : 9609-1980 'English lettering for general engineering drawings'. 

2.1 7"o/era/7ce5 — Tolerances on untoleranced dimensions shall be according to the best prevalent 
manufacturing practices. 

3. Specimen Letters and Numerals

3.4 Roman Numerals and Arrows

4. Material — Suitable steels meeting the requirements laid down in 5. 

Example: 

45C8 of IS : 1570 (Part 2)-1 979 'Schedules for wrought steels : Part 2 Carbon steels (unalloyed 
steels) [first revision)' with a maximum of 0'05 percent each of sulphur and phosphorus contents. 

5. Hardness — The hardness of the punch shall be 370 to 400 HV (^38 to 46 HRC) 

6. Designation — The wood and leather marking punches shall be designated by the commonly used 
name, the letter or numeral size and number of the standard: 

Example 1 

A wood and leather marking punch of capital letter 'A' of size 1*6 mm shall be designated as: 
Marking Punch Capital A — 1*6 IS : 6844 
Example 2 

A wood and leather marking capital letter punch set of capital letters of size 1*6 mm shall be 
designated as: 

Marking Punch Set Capital 1*6 IS : 6844 

Example 3 

A wood and leather marking punch of Hindu-Arabic numeral 4 and of 10 mm size shall be 
designated as: 

Marking Punch HA 4 — 10 IS : 6844 

Example 4 

A wood and leather marking punch set of Roman numerals and of 20 mm size shall be 
designated as: 

Marking Punch Set Roman — 20 IS : 6844 

7. Packing — The wood and leather marking punches shall be supplied in sets \n suitable steel cases. 
The packing shall be in accordance with the best prevalent trade practice. 

8. Marking— The containers of the punches shall be marked with the nominal size in millimetres, 
manufacturer's name, initials or recognised trade-mark and the description of the contents. The appro- 
priate letter or numeral as the case may be shall be engraved on one side of the punch so as to facilitate 
the correct holding of the punch while punching (see figure below). 



u 



Note— The punch for numeral '6' shall be marked on one side with '6' and on other side with '9' for proper 
orientation. 



IS : 6844 -1984 

8.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

9, Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed to between the buyer and the seller the procedure given in 
IS : 2500 (Part 1)-1973 'Sampling inspection tables: Part 1 Inspection by attributes and by count of 
defects, ( //V^^Aem/o/?)' may be followed for sampling inspection. The sampling plan for various 
characteristics shall be as given in 9.1 and 9.2. 

9.1 For dimensions and specimen of letters and numerals, sampling plan with inspection levellll and 
acceptable quality level (AQL) of 25 percent given in Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2500 (Part 1)-1973 shall 
be followed. 

9.2 For hardness, sampling plan with inspection level I and acceptable quality level (AQL) of I'O 
percent as given in Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2500 (Part 1)-1 973, shall be followed. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 
This specification was first issued in 1973. 

The current revision has been taken up in order to include the commonly used symbols. It is 
also in alignment with the latest version of DIN 7354-1978 'Wood and leather marking punches' 
issued by Deutsches Institute fur Normung (DIN).
